title: Why it is time to restate the case for the importance of research on animals | New Scientist
description: Recent progress on alternatives to animal testing is hugely welcome. But talk of "phasing out" animal research completely is misleading and could even be dangerous to scientists
author: New Scientist

title: Satellite data gives clearer picture of how ice sheets are losing mass | New Scientist
description: The longest satellite record ever compiled shows the vast majority of ice loss from Greenland and Antarctica is due to glaciers flowing faster, rather than warmer air temperatures melting them at the surface
author: Alec Luhn

title: How older siblings may shape sexual orientation via mother’s immune system | New Scientist
description: It has long been observed that men with older brothers are more likely to be gay, but an association has also been found with older sisters. This sheds further light on how a mother's immune system may be involved in shaping sexual orientation
author: Linda Geddes

title: Human organoids restore cognition in mice with half a brain | New Scientist
description: Mice with half a brain experienced significant improvements in their cognition and movement when they received brain organoids made from human stem cells
author: Carissa Wong

title: Humpback whale mother with stillborn calf shows 'grief-like' behaviour | New Scientist
description: For the first time, researchers have seen a humpback mother interacting with her stillborn calf, reporting that she stayed close to it for at least two days
author: James Woodford

title: Nuclear fusion experiment produces the brightest X-rays on Earth yet | New Scientist
description: A new twist on nuclear fusion ignition emitted X-rays that are as bright as some stars, which could enable other extreme experiments
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan
